\section[vāhanam]{\sk{वाहनम्} (vāhanam) — a vehicle}

\label{lesson:SA-C75-vehicle}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Sanskrit for a shop, then the Sanskrit for a market.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \sk{वाहनम्}}
\textbf{\sk{वाहनम्}} (\emph{vāhanam}) — \textquotedblleft{}a vehicle\textquotedblright{}, anything that carries you on a \textbf{\sk{यात्रा}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The general word.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vāhanam}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vāhanam}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{vāhanam}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Sanskrit for a shop, then the Sanskrit for a market, then say \emph{vāhanam} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \sk{वाहनम्} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A vehicle\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
